summary: Iteration 2 tested the NEW hub CRUD, default-flag enforcement, /api/geocode fallback, polygon editor, hub-based route planning, plus full regression. 38/38 pytest tests pass (29 prior + 9 new). Frontend Hubs page works end-to-end: list shows 3 seeded red pins, add/delete modal works, geocoder returned real Nominatim results for 'Marina Bay Sands' (Nominatim is NOT blocked in this env as feared), default-enforcement verified. Overview page was broken due to undeclared 'hubs' state — fixed. Zones polygon editor mounts with toggle-draw-mode/undo/clear buttons. Routing page shows hub dropdown. Seed creates 3 hubs/2 HMs/6 drivers/6 vehicles/3 zones/15 orders as required.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED during testing — 'hubs' variable was referenced (hubs.length in stat card, hubs={hubs} on MapView) but never declared in state. Page would crash with ReferenceError before fix. Added useState and /hubs fetch.

action_items: None blocking. The Overview.jsx missing 'hubs' state was fixed by testing agent — main agent should review diff.
Consider extracting a shared MapPickerBase for HubPicker+PolygonEditor (duplicate leaflet setup).

critical_code_review_comments: Overview.jsx referenced undeclared 'hubs' — would crash on load until fixed. This was shipped without smoke-testing the home page.
HubIn does not clamp lat/lng to valid ranges. Consider pydantic validators (-90..90 / -180..180).
update_hub does not preserve created_at (data.model_dump() overwrites only provided fields, but HubIn has no created_at so OK — confirmed safe).
server.py 1195 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; split into routers.
@app.on_event('shutdown') remains deprecated; move to lifespan handler.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all navigable pages load; polygon vertex-click simulation in Playwright hit the background map instead of modal map — test-harness limitation, not an app bug; toggle/undo/clear controls confirmed rendered)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed: 3 hubs (Central/East/West), 2 HMs, 6 drivers, 6 vehicles, 3 zones, 15 orders — matches spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nominatim is actually reachable here — geocode returns real results. /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the 38-test regression suite.
